integrity: Proof by explicit degree decompositions, one-parameter degenerations, affine-bundle charts and irreducible nondegenerate quadric. Finite-field arithmetic is corroborative; mathematical originality and correctness have not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Reduced commuting-pair varieties for exterior algebras of one to six generators over characteristic different from two; no scheme reducedness, generator rank >=7, arbitrary tuples, or characteristic two. The five-generator point count follows from earlier inner-derivation rank work and is a comparison rather than a new claim.
title: The first reducibility transition for commuting pairs in exterior algebras
